newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF functions to be separated in April '98--party.
newsitem.headline: MOF functions to be separated in April '98--party.

text.p: A new body which would take over the inspection and supervisory functions of the Finance Ministry is expected to start operations on April 1, 1998, a senior official of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party told a news conference on Wednesday.

Taku Yamazaki, chairman of the LDP's policy-making and research bureau, made the remarks after the three parties in Japan's loose ruling alliance formally agreed to a plan to reform the powerful Finance Ministry.
Under the agreement, a fully independent body would be established under the Prime Minister's Office to take over the ministry's functions of inspecting and supervising financial institutions.
"We think that the new body will start operations on April 1, 1998," Yamazaki said.
